name: adkit
description: AI agent for managing ads on Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Reddit, X, and Pinterest. Create and publish campaigns, ad sets/groups, and ads; manage drafts; upload images and video; research keywords and audiences; browse the ad library; and generate ads with AI. Works through the AdKit CLI or MCP. Load when the user wants to execute ad operations or is ready to publish a campaign. Not for strategy, copywriting, creative advice, or learning about ads.

findings.excerpt: 2. If `adkit` is not found, install it: `npm i -g @adkit/cli`.
